claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Praziquantel is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines at 2.5 uM, as its anthelmintic activity depends on schistosome-specific calcium channels and tegument disruption that have no relevant counterpart in human cancer cells.
